name: valve-setup
title: Set up Valve
description: Add rate limits and provider feedback to outbound API calls.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/skills/valve-setup/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Set up valvejs in this project. Inspect every outbound call and the deployment topology. Confirm the provider quota and its scope before choosing rules. Use one stable id per shared quota, Redis or Valkey across processes, provider feedback, bounded waiting where needed, and orderly shutdown. Replace existing throttling only where it overlaps. Typecheck and run relevant tests; explain any assumptions.

name: valve-best-practices
title: Review an integration
description: Check quota sharing, retries, queue bounds, and shutdown.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/skills/valve-best-practices/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Review this project's valvejs integration for concrete production risks. Check quota scope, shared stores, call-site coverage, weighted costs, feedback, retry idempotency, waiting bounds, global concurrency, and shutdown. Give file and line references, impact, and fixes. Say what is already correct; do not change code unless asked.

name: valve-migrate-from-bottleneck
title: Migrate from Bottleneck
description: Translate pacing, reservoirs, groups, and concurrency.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/skills/valve-migrate-from-bottleneck/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Migrate this project from Bottleneck to valvejs. Inventory limiter options and call sites first. Preserve priority ordering, clustered concurrency, weighted calls, feedback, and shutdown. Explain reservoir timing and unsupported queue strategies. Use scoped rules for atomic parent and per-key quotas. Plan a cutover without overlapping independent budgets, then typecheck and run relevant tests.

name: valve-quota-design
title: Design quotas
description: Model shared and per-tenant budgets, scopes, and runtime limits.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/skills/valve-quota-design/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Design the valvejs quota model for this project. Confirm which provider budgets each request spends and what they are keyed by. Choose between layered rules, atomic scoped rules, independent keyed groups, or sequential admission with its non-atomic semantics. Address per-key cooldowns, plan tiers, runtime limit changes, capacity, shared stores, and safe policy rollout where relevant.

name: valve-troubleshooting
title: Troubleshoot Valve
description: Diagnose 429 responses, stalled queues, and Redis failures.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/skills/valve-troubleshooting/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Diagnose this project's valvejs issue from the actual code, configuration, and errors. Check shared ids and stores, per-call construction, feedback, rules, queue bounds, leases, and Redis health. Do not delete budgets or reset ids as a workaround. Make the smallest supported fix and verify it with local tests or synthetic responses.

name: valve-contributing
title: Prepare a contribution
description: Follow repository conventions, changesets, and required checks.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/.claude/skills/valve-contributing/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Prepare the requested change in the valve repository. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, inspect the implementation, update the relevant docs and skills, add a changeset only when required, sync the website when changesets change, and run the appropriate checks. Summarize the change, validation, and a proposed PR title. Do not publish a package.

name: valve-perf-harness
title: Benchmark Valve
description: Run the perf harness and interpret safety and performance results.
prompt:
Read https://github.com/ksaurav24/valve/blob/master/.claude/skills/valve-perf-harness/SKILL.md and only the linked references needed for this task. If you cannot access them, say so before proceeding.

Use the valve repository's performance harness for the requested change. Start with doctor, quick, and footprint --check. Read safety separately from performance and label portable results as descriptive. Recommend any further targeted comparison with its cost and prerequisites. Use only disposable harness-owned stores for real-store or fault checks; do not start long runs without a task that calls for them.
